[[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had a '''prison camp''' located on [[Porso Hill]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he established a prison there for Naboo [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] he was supposed to [[Liberation of enslavement camps|rescue]]. The camp had a docking station for his [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|freighter]] and eight buildings. The camp was protected by two [[Missile launcher (Trade Federation)|missile launchers]] and [[Borvo the Hutt's starfighter|starfighters]]. 10 [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser turrets]] were placed on Porso Hill's five endpoints, with the barracks in the middle. The camp was [[Attack on Porso Hill|attacked]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], who forced Borvo to retreat and rescued the slaves.

==Behind the scenes==
The prison camp appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' and received a mention in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
